events.name: The Whispering Door
events.intro: A door standing alone in the grass whispers a riddle: "What walks on four legs at dawn and is never counted?" Only the right answer opens it.

success.text: The latch clicks. Behind the door lies a small hoard.

failure.text: The door laughs softly and stays shut. A chill follows you down the road.

success.text: "Close enough," the door sighs, and swings open on a gift.

failure.text: "Wrong." A cold gust blows your pockets empty of one thing.

success.text: You listen until the whispering turns into a lullaby. Your team rests easy.

events.name: Moss-Covered Obelisk
events.intro: Runes run down a mossy obelisk. Some glow faintly. They look like a warning of something that waits at the end of the road.

success.text: The runes describe the ground ahead. The hidden stops on this stage make sense now.

effects.text: Read the runes of a moss-covered obelisk.

failure.text: The glyphs swim and you leave with a headache.

choices.label: Copy the runes into your notes

success.text: You sketch them carefully. The Research Lab will love this.
Some warnings are best left unread.

events.name: The Echoing Well
events.intro: A stone well that echoes back more than you shout. A sign reads: "Toss a coin and hear what is coming."

success.text: The coin falls for a long time. The well names the road ahead, one stop at a time.
The well gurgles happily and shows you everything it knows.
Your own voice answers: "Careful." You take it to heart.

events.name: The Clockwork Crypt
events.intro: Gears turn behind every wall of this crypt. A door opens only on the beat of the ticking.

choices.label: Time your step with the ticking

success.text: The doors open one after another, exactly on the beat. The vault pays out.

failure.text: A gear snaps shut on your sleeve. You back away, scratched.

success.text: The mechanism grinds to a halt and the crypt gives up a prize.
The ticking follows you for a while.

events.name: The Abandoned Observatory
events.intro: A dome with a cracked lens. If you clean it, the sky might show you what is coming across the whole map.

success.text: The stars line up with the roads below. You can see further ahead.
Heavy, shiny, and worth a lot.
You wake rested, the constellations still behind your eyes.

events.name: The Memory Fog
events.intro: A thick fog rolls in. Your pockets feel lighter, and for a moment you cannot remember what was in them.

success.text: You come out the other side with an uneasy feeling that something was left behind.
The fog lifts and everything is where it was. You even find an extra.

failure.text: The fog thickens and swallows an item before it clears.

events.name: The Fog Gives It Back
events.intro: You suddenly recall exactly what you lost, in order. The memory comes with a little pile of things on the roadside.

success.text: Everything comes back to you, one object at a time.

events.name: The Painted Prophecy Wall
events.intro: A mural shows a tall figure with a team at its side. The paint is fresh, and you know that face.

success.text: The painted team is the gym leader waiting on this stage. You know what you are walking into.

effects.text: Saw the gym leader painted on a prophecy wall.

success.text: You sketch the whole team for the Research Lab.

events.name: The Vanished Village
events.intro: A whole village stands empty. Tables set, doors open, and not a soul in sight. Something happened here.

success.text: Notes, a locked chest, a half-finished letter. Whoever lived here left in a hurry.
The board explains it all: they moved on together before the storm. Their gifts were left for travellers.

effects.text: Learned what happened to the Vanished Village.

failure.text: The writing is too faded to read.

success.text: The quiet is almost kind. Your team stays close.

events.name: The Library of Unwritten Books
events.intro: Rows of blank books. A plaque reads: "Write your own tale and the shelves will answer."

success.text: The pages fill with your words, then rewrite themselves into something stranger.
The ink turns warm. Your team crowds around to read it.
The last line writes itself and the book clicks shut.
The shelves nod, as if that was a story too.

events.name: The Wandering Spirit Guide
events.intro: A pale lantern floats beside the road. A friendly ghost beckons you to follow it, off the path.

success.text: The ghost leads you off the path and points at the ground.
The ghost bows and fades.

events.name: The Spirit's Hiding Spot
events.intro: Under a flat stone, wrapped in cloth, is something the ghost wanted someone to find.

success.text: The ghost smiles, and then is gone for good.

events.name: A Shard of the North
events.intro: Half-buried near a frozen pond, a cold shard of dull glass hums when you touch it. It looks like one piece of something much bigger.

success.text: The shard is warm and heavy. It wants to be near others like it.
You leave it where it lies.

events.name: A Shard of the Marsh
events.intro: Half-buried near a boggy hollow, a damp shard of dull glass hums when you touch it. It looks like one piece of something much bigger.

success.text: The shard is warm and heavy. It wants to be near others like it.
You leave it where it lies.

events.name: A Shard of the Ridge
events.intro: Half-buried near a high cliff, a windy shard of dull glass hums when you touch it. It looks like one piece of something much bigger.

success.text: The shard is warm and heavy. It wants to be near others like it.
You leave it where it lies.

events.name: The Shattered Portal
events.intro: Your three shards rise from your bag and lock together. A doorway of light opens in the air.

success.text: The gate throws you forward, and sets down a gift on the other side.
You map every seam of it for the Research Lab.

events.name: The Ancient Arena Ruins
events.intro: A spectral crowd fills the stands of a ruined arena. They want a show.

success.text: The ghosts roar. Coins and cheers rain down.

failure.text: The crowd boos and a ghostly tomato flies in.

success.text: A spectral fighter steps out.
You enjoy the quiet.

events.name: The Dragon Skeleton Gallery
events.intro: A gallery of bones, each one the size of a house. Touching one makes the air hum with a distant roar.

success.text: A roar echoes in your head, and your team stands taller.
A rush of fire. Your team feels quick.
A fang, yellowed and hard as stone.

events.name: The Frozen Time Garden
events.intro: A garden frozen in a single moment. A leaf hangs in the air mid-fall. Nothing here has ever spoiled.

choices.label: Plant a seedling in the frozen soil

success.text: The seed does not grow here, but it will not die either. You take it with you.
Still perfectly fresh, and they will stay that way.
Time slows around you. Your team rests.

events.name: A Rusted Key
events.intro: A rusted key lies at a muddy riverbank, tagged with a faded symbol of a vault.

success.text: A key to something sealed. You hope you will find the door.
You leave it where it lies.

events.name: A Bronze Key
events.intro: A bronze key lies at the roots of a dead tree, tagged with a faded symbol of a vault.

success.text: A key to something sealed. You hope you will find the door.
You leave it where it lies.

events.name: A Silver Key
events.intro: A silver key lies at a collapsed signpost, tagged with a faded symbol of a vault.

success.text: A key to something sealed. You hope you will find the door.
You leave it where it lies.

events.name: The Sealed Vault Door
events.intro: A round door, three keyholes. Your three keys fit exactly.

success.text: The door rolls aside on silent hinges, and the vault is not empty.

events.name: The Totem's Whisper
events.intro: A small Totem shrine hums. If you kneel, it promises to whisper what is coming.

success.text: The Totem whispers the name of the gym leader ahead. Good fortune follows.
The Totem hums warmly, and your team seems stronger.

events.name: The Starfall Seeker
events.intro: A stargazer with a telescope says the sky has picked a lucky stop for you. She will say which, if you listen.

success.text: "Hidden stops will show themselves today."
She hands over a hand-drawn chart of the road.
"Luck is luck," she says, shrugging.

events.name: The Hidden Graveyard Choir
events.intro: Ghosts sing in a forgotten graveyard. The song is lovely and a little sad. They hold a place for you.

success.text: You hum along. A cold, kind blessing settles over your team.
Your Ghost-type knows the tune. The choir lifts it high and thanks you.
You leave a flower and walk on.

events.name: The Underwater Ruins
events.intro: Ruined pillars show under the clear water. Something glints on the bottom.

success.text: Your Water-type swims straight to the treasure room.
You grab something and surface gasping.

failure.text: The pull of the current is too strong.

success.text: The pillars glow at dusk. Quiet.

events.name: The Cursed Idol
events.intro: A small golden idol on a pedestal. The air around it is wrong.

success.text: Gold coins spill out of your bag, but your Pokémon will not look at the idol.
You step back. The idol seems to watch you go.

events.name: Return the Idol
events.intro: The idol is heavy in your bag. A small shrine on the road has a pedestal the exact size of it.

success.text: A weight lifts. A warm light settles over your team.

effects.text: Returned the Cursed Idol to its shrine.

success.text: You walk on, richer and a little colder.

events.name: The Rift Whisper
events.intro: A crack in the air speaks in a voice bigger than the sky. A legend offers a bargain.

success.text: Power comes, and a price with it.

effects.text: Struck a bargain with a legendary voice in a rift.

success.text: The voice sighs. "Then listen."
The rift closes with a small sigh.

events.name: The Eclipse
events.intro: The sun slips behind the moon in the middle of the day. Shadows go sharp.

success.text: The darkness feels like an ally. Dark-type moves hit harder.
You wait out the darkness together.

events.name: The Mirage Merchant
events.intro: A merchant shimmers at the edge of the road. "Pay up front," she says. "I tend to vanish."

success.text: She hands over a fine, real bundle before the heat haze takes her.

failure.text: You hand over the coins. She smiles, and she is gone.

success.text: She grins. "Half now, half never!" Half price, still a real deal.

failure.text: She frowns and fades from view.

success.text: The mirage thins and is gone.

events.name: The Echo Chamber of Rivals
events.intro: A round chamber that plays back what your rivals have said to you. Some of it is kinder than you remember.

success.text: Hearing them gives you a new view of the rivalry.

effects.text: Heard the echoes of my rivals' words.

success.text: You say what you never said to their faces. Feels good.

events.name: A Torn Page
events.intro: A torn page drifts across the road, covered in old handwriting. It is part of a longer story.

success.text: You tuck it away carefully.
It flutters off into the grass.

events.name: A Torn Page
events.intro: A torn page drifts across the road, covered in old handwriting. It is part of a longer story.

success.text: You tuck it away carefully.
It flutters off into the grass.

events.name: A Torn Page
events.intro: A torn page drifts across the road, covered in old handwriting. It is part of a longer story.

success.text: You tuck it away carefully.
It flutters off into the grass.

events.name: The Story Collector
events.intro: A scholar spots the pages in your hand and gasps. "Those belong together!"

success.text: She reads them aloud. A whole forgotten tale fills the room, and she pays you in coin and research.

effects.text: Pieced together a lost story from torn pages.

success.text: Some stories are yours alone.

events.name: The Archivist's Dilemma
events.intro: An archivist holds two scrolls. "I can only keep one in the great archive. Which history should be remembered?"

choices.label: The history of the great trainers

success.text: She files it carefully. Your team feels the weight of legend.

effects.text: Chose the history of the great trainers over the old Pokémon.

choices.label: The history of the wild Pokémon

success.text: She files it carefully. Your team seems relaxed.

effects.text: Chose the history of the wild Pokémon over the great trainers.

success.text: She sighs, and tries. Both scrolls are a little worn from it.

events.name: The Door Without a Wall
events.intro: A door stands in the middle of the field with no wall around it. Walk around it, and there is nothing. Walk through it...

success.text: The world folds. You emerge further down the road.
You see only grass. The door is gone when you glance back.

events.name: The Final Page
events.intro: The last page of a great book, left open. Reading it will decide how the rest of your run feels.

success.text: Your team feels bold, and the foes grow bolder.
Your team feels cherished and a little less fierce.
Your pockets feel heavier, and your bag lighter.
Some endings are better unread.

events.name: The Hall of Past Champions
events.intro: A hall of statues, each a past champion. The caretaker coughs: "They tend to move for a donation."

success.text: Two statues stride out to fight beside you against a rival who just walked in.
You learn a lot by looking.

events.name: Ancient Gym Remains: Ember Wing
events.intro: A crumbling wing of an ancient gym, still guarded by its fire-type keeper. A forgotten badge lies under the dust.

success.text: The keeper wakes and raises a team.
The gym sleeps on.

events.name: Ancient Gym Remains: Tide Wing
events.intro: A crumbling wing of an ancient gym, still guarded by its water-type keeper. A forgotten badge lies under the dust.

success.text: The keeper wakes and raises a team.
The gym sleeps on.

events.name: Ancient Gym Remains: Leaf Wing
events.intro: A crumbling wing of an ancient gym, still guarded by its grass-type keeper. A forgotten badge lies under the dust.

success.text: The keeper wakes and raises a team.
The gym sleeps on.

events.name: The Forgotten Badges
events.intro: Three forgotten badges glow in your bag. A hidden door in the old gym opens for them.

success.text: A cache of old prizes, kept for whoever could earn the three.

events.name: Poltergeist Poker
events.intro: Ghosts deal cards from a mouldy deck. They play for items.

success.text: Your hand beats the table. The ghosts pay up with ghostly good grace.

failure.text: A card floats out of your sleeve and a ghost sweeps the pot.

success.text: You pick up a few tricks.

events.name: The Rewind Gate
events.intro: A gate with a single clock face. Pay, and it turns back time on one choice.

success.text: The hands spin back. You see the next reward more clearly this time.
The hands turn and turn.

events.name: The Cartographer's Studio
events.intro: A studio full of maps, many half-painted. The cartographer offers to fill yours in.

success.text: Her brush finds every hidden corner of the map.
A small sketch of the road ahead.

events.name: The Spectral Duelist
events.intro: A ghostly trainer bows. "I fight only the moves you have used before."

success.text: The duelist's team mirrors yours.
The duelist returns the bow and vanishes.

events.name: The Mind Palace
events.intro: A room of memories. You can relive one, and take its lesson with you.

success.text: The thrill returns.
The calm returns.
The sting returns, and so does the wisdom.

events.name: The Sleeping Titan's Dream
events.intro: A mountain breathes. Inside it, something vast is dreaming. You can step into the dream.

success.text: The titan stirs, and the dream takes shape.
You tiptoe away. Your team seems proud of you.
